summary: No qualified Dallas industrial rent comps were identified within 8 miles and with execution dates from 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31. Most executed Dallas records were superseded by executed amendments relocating the market to Seattle as of 2026-08-20 (e.g., S-R2562/U-R2562-6, S-R3079/U-R3079-5, S-R7814/U-R7814-7, S-R4703/U-R4703-8, S-R5413/U-R5413-10, S-R4514/U-R4514-9, S-R3428/U-R3428-4). The remaining Dallas records failed eligibility due to missing required fields (e.g., rent, term, free months, TI, or gross-expense detail), out-of-radius, out-of-window, or asking/unsigned status. As a result, the shortlist is empty.
limitations: Several executed amendments changed the market to Seattle shortly before the cutoff; if these reflect administrative recoding rather than physical location, potential Dallas comps could be inadvertently excluded.
Multiple records lacked required inputs (TI, free months, or gross expense detail), preventing effective rent computation under the specified convention.
One executed lease (S-R1562) falls within the date window but was published after the cutoff and was excluded per instructions.
No discounting or present value adjustments were applied by convention; even with complete data, results would reflect undiscounted rent-only figures.
